projects.title: Novaco — AI Agents for Automotive Dealerships
projects.description: Built an AI platform that automates customer interactions and back-office operations for automotive dealerships. LLM-powered agents handle inbound inquiries, qualify leads, book appointments, and manage conversations 24/7 — wired directly into dealership systems so sales and service teams stop losing time on repetitive messaging and never miss a lead.

projects.title: RedxChess — Neural-Network Chess Engine
projects.description: Designed a strong custom chess engine with neural-network-based position evaluation and highly optimized bitboard move generation. Implements modern search — alpha-beta with quiescence, null-move pruning, and late-move reductions — behind a standard UCI interface, so it plugs into any chess GUI and plays at a competitive level.

projects.title: Navispace — Open-Innovation Platform
projects.description: Delivered front-end engineering for Navispace's open-innovation platform that connects startups and enterprises through event-driven programs and global collaboration tools. Built responsive, accessible interfaces with Office 365 integration to support large-scale, cross-organization innovation programs.

projects.title: VoteChain — On-Chain Voting dApp
projects.description: Built secure, transparent on-chain voting for communities and organizations. Configurable ballots, real-time reporting, and tamper-proof auditable results backed by Ethereum smart contracts, with ballot data stored on IPFS and one-click wallet authentication via MetaMask.

projects.title: Barbell Medicine — E-commerce & AI Support
projects.description: Contributed platform engineering to Barbell Medicine's strength-training education and e-commerce site, including WooCommerce features and an AI chatbot for customer support. Delivered scalable WordPress architecture that handles high traffic and a growing product and content catalog.

projects.title: CoverLetterGPT — AI Cover-Letter SaaS
projects.description: Shipped a full-stack AI SaaS that generates personalized cover letters from a job description and resume in seconds. Built on the Wasp framework with GPT-4 generation, Stripe subscription billing, and a React job-management UI — a complete, monetized product from idea to live paying users.

projects.title: CertOnce — AI + Blockchain Credential Verification
projects.description: Led architecture and engineering for CertOnce's tamper-proof certificate platform, combining AI document validation with on-chain verification on Ethereum and Hyperledger. Owned scalability, security, and infrastructure decisions end-to-end, giving issuers and verifiers instant, fraud-proof credential checks through the company's early-stage growth.

projects.title: Phoenix — Voice-Controlled Desktop AI Assistant
projects.description: Built a JARVIS-inspired desktop AI assistant that runs locally. Voice-activated system control, task management, natural-language query answering, and workflow automation in a single agent — combining speech recognition, the OpenAI API, and direct OS automation for hands-free productivity.

projects.title: Ceiling & Drylining Supplies — B2B E-commerce
projects.description: Built a UK construction-supplies e-commerce platform on Shopify covering drylining, ceilings, insulation, and tools. B2B trade accounts, bulk ordering, integrated payment gateways, inventory management, and nationwide delivery across a multi-brand product catalog.
